additional_info.subject: 0478721 - ID0478721-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP/RD170003095] REQUEST CONVERTER SERIALNUMBER CRM:00314000263
additional_info.body:
Dear colleagues,
Today I supported Szymon to solve issue of charger
MP/RD 1700003095
not passing the Request Converter SerialNumber phase.
I checked remotely and the charger was not able to read any converter serial number. The issue was on a false contact on the contactor XD14.1A closing the CAN. Once the contactor has been checked and correctly connected, the charger configured correctly and completed converter grouping.
I will close the ticket has the issue is solved.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
eMobility Customer Service
Technical Support Engineer
